bagPolicy.summary: Lenovo Center does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is accessible via Edwards Mill Road from I-40 or Wade Avenue. The main entrance to the Lenovo Center parking lots is on the left. For detailed parking options and pricing, refer to the Parking Guide.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Lenovo Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Lenovo Center offers a variety of food and drink options including gourmet hot dogs, fresh-breaded chicken, and signature mac & cheese bowls. Special offerings include Sup Crush branded vodka drinks and Cheerwine Slushies.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Lenovo Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exit / Re-entry into Lenovo Center is NOT permitted, including for smoking.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: To purchase tickets, call 919-865-1510, or visit the NC State Ticket Office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Lenovo Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
